orders.detail: body carries no penaltyCapNative for this order; expected value shown (as of 2026-09-07 only the staging autopilots publish it)

not_verifiable: the correlated-token override sets and the usd reference token are autopilot deployment config, not published; the replay uses CIP-87's numbers plus a per-chain USDC default and marks any regime it had to infer (`inferred: true`)

a stale usd reference price (the autopilot keeps its last value when the reference token has no price in a cycle) is only observable when a prior body carried one: the replay uses this auction's price, else the most recent prior body's within --retained-lookback (reported as retained), else it reports the minimum reference price that reproduces the published cap
usd reference token on plasma is ASSUMED (0xb8ce59fc3717ada4c02eadf9682a9e934f625ebb); it only matters where the bound binds
the 1 bps default factor for plasma is the CIP-87 text value; it has not yet been confirmed by a published cap in the volume-factor regime (the core team may retune within 0-10 bps with notice)

the CIP text defines the basis as the order's quote (net of volume fees); the implementation values the signed sell side (sell orders) or buy side (buy orders) at reference prices - the replay follows the implementation; the CIP's scaling to the executed fraction of a partial fill happens at penalty time and is not part of the published per-order cap
disclaimer: cow-certify is independent and not affiliated with CoW Protocol; this replay recomputes a rewards-accounting parameter from public data and reports differences, it does not adjudicate them.
